name: Driggsby
description:
Ever feel like you should be doing more with your money, but aren’t sure where to start?

Driggsby gives Claude a secure, up-to-date view of your financial life through Plaid. That means clearer answers, better context, and less uncertainty about where things stand.

With Claude Scheduled Tasks, you can make staying informed a recurring habit without adding another task to your day. Set the review and schedule once, then let Claude deliver the summary.

Driggsby has read-only access and cannot move money. Your bank credentials never touch Driggsby’s servers.

Free during public beta.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Driggsby to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Driggsby to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.driggsby.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Driggsby MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Driggsby lists 16 MCP tools, including archive_custom_asset_or_liability, create_custom_asset_or_liability, email_me, export_cash_transactions, get_overview, list_accounts, list_assets_and_liabilities, list_findings, list_investment_holdings, list_outstanding_debts, list_recurring_transactions, and query_cash_sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Driggsby?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Driggsby in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Driggsby requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Driggsby is developed by The Good Software Company, LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
